card.name: Scattered words in running web prose
card.fires_on: No single word or setting; it fires on assorted short words such as a, forget, me, make, add, it and to in general web text, mostly just before the sentence continues.
card.plain: No single pattern stands out. It responds to assorted short words in ordinary web writing, mostly just before the sentence continues.
